title: David Unaipon's birth chart
metaDescription: David Unaipon's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 5.3° Libra. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Four of the ten placements whose signs are settled stand in Leo — the Moon, Mars, Jupiter and Uranus. The placements whose signs could change with an unknown hour are not counted. A cluster that size becomes the section the rest of the chart plays around.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: Libra, but precisely: 5.3°, first decan, 0°–10°, under Venus in the triplicity scheme. The tradition kept these divisions because thirty degrees is a long street.

blocks.title: The fast planets
blocks.text: Day to day the chart speaks through Mercury in Virgo (23.5°), Venus in Libra (25.2°), Mars in Leo (25.4°): a mind that trusts the measured and the checked, taste led by wit and proportion, drive that ignites on contact.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: The tightest geometry in the chart puts Mars a third of the circle apart from Neptune, 0.1° off exact. The scheme reads trines as water finding its level: effortless, and invisible to the person living it. Behind it, Venus sextile Mars at 0.2°, and the Sun sextile Uranus at 0.2° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. Each angle here was measured at every hour of the civil day and held; whatever the missing clock said, this geometry was in it.

blocks.title: Figures in the geometry
blocks.text: The Moon stands apart from every major angle the day held — the tradition reads an unaspected planet as a voice that speaks on its own schedule, unmodulated by the rest of the chart.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: Four planets here sit in a sign the classical scheme scores. The Sun in Libra at 5.3° is in fall — the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given; Mercury in Virgo at 23.5° is in exaltation — the tradition’s honoured-guest placement, working at its best; Venus in Libra at 25.2° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules; Saturn in Capricorn at 14.7° is in domicile. Condition, not character: that is all the dignity table ever measured.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Of the 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day: 5 in fire, 3 in earth, 2 in air by element, 5 fixed, 4 cardinal, 1 mutable by modality. No settled placement falls in water — an absence the tradition treats as information, not as a defect. Neptune and Pluto were retrograde — the optical reversal the tradition reads as review — energy turned over before it is turned out.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Leo for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 11.9° between midnight and midnight. Whatever the unrecorded hour was, it happened inside one Moon sign — the degree floats, the sign holds. At the noon reference it stands at 14.0°.
